bucketMeaning.gl: WebGL2 + OpenAL + GLFW. Bound straight to the canvas context, the AudioContext and the window; nothing emulated.
bucketMeaning.fd: wasi file descriptors, clock and time. Backed by @online-gal/vfs (SyncFileBridge over HTTP range reads), not by a real filesystem.
bucketMeaning.asyncify: on-demand payload fetch, and the stack spill Asyncify unwinds through. The paths that cannot be synchronous: a range read has to leave the wasm and come back.
bucketMeaning.async: the Asyncify re-entry trampolines. Each is one unwound call site: resume it, run it, rewind its arguments, then return to whatever yielded.
bucketMeaning.eh: C++ exceptions and longjmp. The module was built without exceptions, so these exist only to make a failure unwind.
bucketMeaning.runtime: Emscripten/musl runtime plumbing: heap growth, thread bookkeeping, environment, string formatting. Modern JS supplies these directly.
bucketMeaning.todo: Known not to need a real implementation yet, with the reason recorded on the row. Nothing hides in here silently.
